items.rootCause: The app's Reduced Motion decision, useReduceMotion() in apps/mobile/src/theme/motion.ts, took the phone's value from Reanimated's useReducedMotion(). Reanimated reads that value once, when the JS bundle loads, and never updates it (its own doc: "returns whether reduced motion was enabled when the app started"). If the phone's animations were turned off while the app was open (the QA case: animator, transition and window scales set to 0 on a running app), the app stayed in full motion until a restart. Every timing in the report matches the full-motion sequence measured from the hero, which shows reduce was false: cards at ~0.8 s (crownAt 700 + awardsStagger 150), the action bar at ~1.9 s (actionsAt 1900), the glide at ~1.2 s (ratingCountAt 1200). The glide is an animated scrollTo, and with the phone's animator at 0 it lands as one jump. The rating count was the same full-motion path. useStackEntered was not the cause: the rest of the screen arrived before the 850 ms rise delay. Under real Reduced Motion, enteringFor() already uses a 200 ms fade with no delay for every section and for the bar, and the glide and count are gated on `reduce`. Caveat: spec §4.1 (docs/01-SPEC.md line 275, Moshe 31.10.2026) says the app's Reduced Motion is OFF by default even when the phone reduces motion. With the in-app setting at its default 'off', full motion on a phone with animations off is the specified behaviour. The bug is real only for 'כמו במכשיר' (system), which this fix covers, and 'on' already worked.
items.fix: theme/motion.ts: useReduceMotion now reads the phone's setting live. It starts from Reanimated's value at app start.
